title: Reseller Tiers and the Professional Email Annual Conversion
content:
**Reseller programme schedule — annual conversion.** The account-tier rate of a Professional Email annual conversion is the email discount percentage that Harborline Customer Accounts sets for the tier recorded on the account on the charge date.

A Microsoft 365 subscription takes no account-tier rate whatever the tier. For a Harborline Mail subscription:

| Tier recorded on the account | Account-tier rate |
|---|---|
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | Platinum email discount percentage |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | Gold email discount percentage |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | Silver email discount percentage |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | Bronze email discount percentage |
| any other tier | none |

The account-tier rate reduces the annual component of an annual conversion once, before it is rounded; no other percentage is added to it or compounded with it, and it never reduces a fee or a credit.

Example (hypothetical): a Harborline Reseller Platinum account converting a monthly Harborline Mail Starter subscription takes the Platinum email discount percentage on the annual component.
